snippet.title: Deadly Delivery - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Deadly Delivery is an online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Watch the Deadly Delivery trailer to see gameplay, learn about silly tools, and see some of the funny deaths that await you in the dungeon. Deadly Delivery is available now on Meta Quest and Steam VR. The trailer also unveils a Deadly Delivery and Ancient Dungeon VR collaboration is coming soon.
